name: personal-claude-setups
description: Cory Hanson's personal Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: resolve-pr-feedback
plugins.description: Systematically fetch, evaluate, and resolve GitHub PR review feedback — gated on human approval by default, or fully autonomous in auto mode, escalating only the calls it isn't sure of.

plugins.name: explore-haiku
plugins.description: Overrides Claude Code's built-in Explore agent to always run on Haiku instead of inheriting the session model, cutting cost and latency on every exploration dispatch.

plugins.name: dotnet-dev
plugins.description: Skills and subagents for .NET/C# development. Skills carry the authoring conventions Claude must follow inline — API endpoints, Blazor/MudBlazor components, xUnit tests, database migrations, Serilog logging. Agents handle delegated sweeps — security review, logging audit, feature-flag removal, documentation.

plugins.name: subagent-orchestration
plugins.description: An orchestrator-first development style: the main session triages and dispatches, never edits. Ships a ladder of worker agents at fixed model/effort tiers — haiku/low through opus/high, across investigate, implement, and review lanes — plus the orchestrate skill carrying the triage rubric, escalation protocol, and dispatch-brief contract.
